name: KINS 5224
title: Mental Health and Well-Being for the Individual in Sport and Exercise
description: Prepares healthcare providers, coaches, and other sport or exercise professionals working in demanding environments with the knowledge and strategies necessary to prioritize their mental health and well-being. With a focus on resilience, job satisfaction, work-life balance, burnout prevention, and effective coping strategies, students will gain a deeper understanding of the mental health challenges unique to working in sport, exercise or healthcare.
requirement_description: No requirements to take this course.
